test_create_new_insight_widget.title: Create an LPR insight widget with the shared Insights flow

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then click the Widgets tab.
steps.expected: The Widgets tab opens with a Create New Widget button.

steps.action: Click Create New Widget and enter a unique widget name.
steps.expected: The widget form shows the name.

steps.action: Choose Line as the graph type, Event as the category, and License Plate Recognition as the description, then choose the configured test site.
steps.expected: The form shows the chosen values.
A toast confirms the widget was created and the widget is listed by its name.

test_verify_widget_in_lpr_dropdown.title: A created LPR widget appears in the camera page Widgets panel

steps.action: On Insights, create a Line widget for the Event category with the License Plate Recognition description and the configured test site.
steps.expected: A toast confirms the widget was created.

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.

steps.expected: The Widgets panel opens and shows widget cards.

steps.action: Type the widget name in the panel's Search field.
steps.expected: Exactly one card is listed, and it carries the widget name.

test_select_widget_checkbox.title: Place a widget on the LPR page by dragging its card to a tile

steps.action: On Insights, create a Line widget for the Event category with the License Plate Recognition description and the configured test site.
steps.expected: A toast confirms the widget was created.

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
Click the Widgets header, then type the widget name in the panel's Search field.
Drag the card onto the last empty tile.
steps.expected: The tile fills with the widget and one fewer empty tile remains.
